en.headline: Youth suicides hit near 10-year high in 2025, NGO says
en.dek: Samaritan Befrienders Hong Kong reported 47 deaths among those aged 19 or under last year, up more than 30 per cent, while the overall suicide rate fell.
body: The number of suicides among people aged 19 or younger rose to 47 in 2025, the highest in nearly a decade, according to provisional figures cited by Samaritan Befrienders Hong Kong.

The organisation said the youth figure represented an increase of more than 30 per cent from 35 cases in 2024. Overall suicides across all ages fell to 1,019, or 13.57 per 100,000 population, down from a 10-year peak of 1,138 the previous year. Young people were the only age group to record a significant rise.

Executive director David Cheng Chung called for regular risk screening and specialised intervention services tailored to teenagers. The group’s crisis intervention centre handled 1,147 cases last year, including 228 involving people aged 19 or below.

zh.headline: 2025年青少年自殺數字近十年最高
zh.dek: 撒瑪利亞會指19歲或以下自殺死亡個案增至47宗，升逾三成，惟整體自殺率下跌。
body: 撒瑪利亞會引用暫准數字顯示，2025年19歲或以下人士自殺死亡個案增至47宗，為近十年最高。
該會表示，青少年個案較2024年的35宗上升逾三成。全港整體自殺死亡數字則跌至1,019宗，即每10萬人13.57宗，低於前年十年高峰的1,138宗。青少年是唯一錄得顯著升幅的年齡組別。
總幹事鄭重呼籲加強定期風險篩查，以及為青少年提供專門介入服務。該會危機介入中心去年處理1,147宗個案，其中228宗涉及19歲或以下人士。
